errors: check.py (bf16 vs fp32) for the 3B model was OOM-killed (rc 137): 12 GB fp32 weights in 15 GB RAM; disclosed in LOG.md and the post rather than retried
first scale.py test resampled a 4-point vector in the bootstrap and hit a singular fit; test widened to 40 points

doc_friction.issue: writes p to six decimals; fine for 0.5B/1.5B but the 3B model puts 17% of scores below 1e-5, so logit-scale analysis is resolution-limited. A 7B run should store log-odds.
pre-registration table had silently omitted the 2026-11-17 milestone-5 row; added with the new one

deviations.why: added an exploratory logit-scale analysis after the pre-registered outcome, because the 3B model saturates to No and the pre-registered probability-scale slope measured saturation as much as knowledge
deviations.did: labelled exploratory everywhere (LOG, summary, README, paper, post); pre-registered verdicts left as scored
deviations.result: logit slope 1.30, tradition-only; estimator still no better than the source share

deviations.why: used Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct (Qwen Research Licence, not Apache) because the 7B in bf16 does not fit 15 GB RAM and 3B keeps the scale comparison within one family
deviations.did: research use only, no weights redistributed, licence disclosed in LOG/README

notes: Pre-registered: 3 held, 2 partly held (slope fell to 0.02 vs predicted 0.10-0.35; AUC 0.5599 vs floor 0.56). Local checks: 82 project tests pass, check_numbers 115/115, build.py ok, check_md_links ok, check_posts ok.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a researcher running a 2-hour LLM scoring job, writing a pre-registered analysis, exploratory follow-up, paper edits and a post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
